generic_domain.justification: Control systems is the most generic and comprehensive research domain listed as it provides a broad framework for all areas related to controlling processes or systems. It encompasses narrower domains such as control algorithms, discrete control, and robust control. Control algorithms are often used within control systems to implement specific functionalities, while discrete control deals with digital systems, which is just one aspect of broader control systems. Robust control focuses on ensuring stability under varying conditions, another specific area within the larger scope of control systems. Therefore, 'control systems' serves as an umbrella term that includes all these more specialized domains.
